jemma_marketing: Quick update from yesterday9s interview with Helionix. Notes + two short clips uploaded: https://drive.redwood/helionix. We captured a clear anecdote about switching to Dedicated and the impact on tail latency. Need: approved quote, legal release confirmation, and a webinar abstract. Target publish: June 3 embargo.

noah_growth: Love the tail latency angle. Sales requested a CTA that funnels webinar signups into the "mid-market demo" queue. Also asking for a single slide showing 95th percentile latency before/after.

sara_prod: We can produce that P95 chart from the post-migration logs. Ask Helionix to confirm we can publish the chart (it has customer metrics).

alan_legal: Please attach the signed media release. Also tag me on any specific numbers; we'll need a short approval from their legal team for charts or % figures.

jemma_marketing: Release uploaded and transcript attached. I drafted three quote options (one executive-level, one product-focused, one customer-impact). Link: https://drive.redwood/helionix/quotes.

mila_design: Once the quote text is locked, I9ll make a hero banner and a 30s animated clip for socials. Proposed asset pack due June 1 EOD.

kai_sales: For routing: add utm=helionix and tag registrants with prospect-segment: midmarket. Sales follow-up cadence: demo within 48 hours of attendance.

asset-uploader-bot: Reminder: marketing asset freeze set at timestamp 1757880000 (June 1 20:00 UTC).

alan_legal: Quick note 1: Avoid claims like "Xx% faster" unless Helionix signs off. Note 2: If chart contains raw numbers, we need a data-sharing attestation. Sending a short approval template.

noah_growth: If we can9t publish % numbers, we can still use qualitative copy: "significant P95 improvement" and use the chart without raw axes labels.

sara_prod: I can generate a sanitized chart (no raw axes labels) for marketing and retain the detailed chart in the case study appendix for enterprise sales if they request it.

jemma_marketing: Derek (Helionix) okayed the exec quote: "Redwood Dedicated helped us stabilize latency during peak traffic." He9ll ask for legal sign-off on the chart numbers by Friday.

mila_design: Great. I9ll start mockups with the qualitative chart and two CTA variants: "Register for the Helionix webinar" and "See the full case study".

kai_sales: Recommend webinar time Wed June 3 at 10am PT to catch EMEA late afternoon. We9ll enable recordings and send the gated replay.

jemma_marketing: Plan: lock quote + legal OK by Friday, finalize assets by June 1, publish embargo June 3 morning. I9ll post final assets in this thread and ping sales for the routing details. :rocket:
